entities.name: show progress as it is made

triples.evidence: - Verbose logging: status checklists refreshed at every step, naming what is running, what it found, and the numbers so far
- Info density: docs and replies lead with numbers, tables, sources and "say it" lines; appendices for depth; no filler.
- Visual density: diagrams, charts, screenshots and live renders wherever they carry information; a deliverable without a picture needs a reason.

triples.o: show progress as it is made
triples.evidence: - Show progress as it is made: intermediate screenshots and partial results go into the thread (status, then a reply at milestones), not only the final result.
